quote: Unless otherwise provided by ordinance of the local authority having jurisdiction, a person shall not: Stop, stand or park a vehicle in any other alley in such a manner, or under such conditions as to leave available less than 10 feet of the width of the alley for the free movement of vehicular traffic.

activation.condition: A responsible person stops, stands or parks a motor vehicle in a source-qualified other alley.

exceptions.description: Local authority ordinance otherwise provides, if source-proven and applicable.
exceptions.source_clause: Unless otherwise provided by ordinance of the local authority having jurisdiction

judgment_calls_needed.note: Public highway, city block, rear access, abutting property and through-connected non-cul-de-sac status require source review.
Continuous clear width is measured from original bodies, but realized free vehicular movement requires physical traffic review.
Local jurisdiction, ordinance text, effective period and applicability require independent source review.

obligation.description: Do not leave less than 10 feet of the alley width available for free movement of vehicular traffic.

timing.description: Measure original occupied cross-sections throughout the actual parked hold.
